title: KS-968: Per environment, what should happen to the account holding admin@secuura.com on first boot?
bluf: PR #1485 is merged. In the 'both rows present, no ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD' state its first boot SUSPENDS the account holding admin@secuura.com (locks out anyone logging in as that address). Setting ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD instead re-activates the email row as system_admin, even if it was an OWNER. Which environment is in which state is unknown; the ticket forbids probing demo. The triage reports the fix is deployed to kintsugi; the ticket text does not say so (unverified). Credentials and login access at stake; no client sees it.

sources.quote: the first boot of this code suspends the account that holds admin@secuura.com
RE-ACTIVATES the EMAIL row as system_admin
Which outcome each environment gets is Kam's choice

options.label: Accept suspension of the email-row account; use the id row (read-only check first)
options.detail: Matches the fix's intent (KS-966 F3). Deploy seat checks each environment read-only first; kintsugi first, demo only on your word. No production change yet.

options.label: Set ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD per environment (production credential change)
options.detail: Keeps that login active but the gate flagged it re-activates the email row as system_admin, even if it was an OWNER.

options.label: Hold: no demo deploy of #1485, no password change; read-only look at kintsugi only
options.detail: Nothing changes in production. Per-environment decision waits for the read-only state.

default_action: After 48 h option c applies: no ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD change and no demo deploy of #1485; only a read-only look at kintsugi. Safest and reversible.
